cand.title: International Conference on Geospatial Technologies and Civil Engineering Applications
cand.excerpt: Direct segment relevance, but weak source and incumbent venue warrant verification only.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No actual event buyer, organizing chair, PCO or housing manager was verified. Two publisher-side referral candidates are identified below: Andrew Fernandes, editor, and Nermin Dzaferbegovic, Supervisor Agenda Conferences in the 2025 imprint. Neither is established as a buyer or contract controller; Nermin’s current appointment requires confirmation. Sources: https://swiss-congress.ch/contact/ ; https://www.yumpu.com/en/document/view/70863455/swiss-congress-magazine-2025
findings.futureEdition: Swiss Congress explicitly publishes activity dates, not article dates: “Join ICGTCE-27 in Geneva, Switzerland, on 5–6 June 2027”, followed by “5 June 2027 — 6 June 2027” and “8:00 am”. These dates fall within the requested horizon. This establishes an advertised edition only: no matching original-organizer registration page or independent venue confirmation was located. No later edition through June 2028 was established. Source: https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: weak current-edition fit. The advertised meeting is at a central-Geneva hotel, whereas YOTEL Geneva Lake is in Founex. Consider only an expressly permitted satellite room block or ancillary workshop after confirming unconstrained lodging and transport requirements. For a future relocated residential workshop, the supplied six meeting rooms and approximately 250-theatre ceiling could be relevant, but attendance, room demand and catering requirements are unknown. Do not propose the whole 237-room hotel or assume banquet capability. There is no sourced resort preference, airport-arrival pattern or La Côte lodging requirement. Event-location sources: https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/ ; https://www.bernina-geneve.ch/
findings.venueCommitments: Exact advertised venue: Bernina Hotel Geneva. The hotel itself confirms 22 Place Cornavin, Geneva, Switzerland; French tourism material places it opposite the central station. Territory: Geneva city / Canton of Geneva, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte or the Geneva Airport corridor. Swiss Congress lists the venue but does not evidence a signed commitment. No event-specific confirmation from the hotel was located. Sources: https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/ ; https://www.bernina-geneve.ch/ ; https://www.geneve.com/fr/hotels/hotel-bernina
findings.historicalRotation: No verified rotation or annual recurrence for this event owner was established. A same-title ICGTCE-26 was advertised by World Research Forum for 17–18 August 2026 in Geneva, with physical and virtual participation. Its relationship to the June 2027 listing is unverified; it must not be treated as a completed predecessor, annual series, or evidence of venue rotation. Sources: https://www.wrfconference.com/event/index.php?id=100580445 ; https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. The edition listing says only “Bernina Hotel Geneva”; it contains no housing-bureau appointment, accommodation booking instructions, negotiated rate, room allocation, or open RFP. Bernina Hotel Geneva is the only hotel named for this edition. Its hotel status does not prove an accommodation commitment. No published attendance, peak rooms or room-night demand was located. Source: https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/
findings.organizationStructure: Swiss Congress is a conference-publicity/editorial platform, not an established owner of this event. Its contact page says “The publisher of Swiss Congress has hired Andrew Fernandes, an international journalist, as editor” and “Our sole goal is in publicizing your conferences”. The imprint identifies DS Media GmbH as Publishing House; German corporate material describes its business as “Betreiben eines Verlagswesens (analog/digital)”. Actual event owner, association status and any agency/PCO relationship remain unknown. Sources: https://swiss-congress.ch/contact/ ; https://www.yumpu.com/en/document/view/70863455/swiss-congress-magazine-2025 ; https://www.moneyhouse.ch/de/company/ds-media-gmbh-11580686021
findings.competitiveLimitations: Bernina is the advertised competing hotel and has 87 rooms according to its official accommodation page and Geneva Tourism. That is property inventory, not delegate attendance or a conference allocation. No sell-out, overflow, capacity shortfall or displaced-room evidence was located; do not derive overflow from its room count. Its central-station location creates a plausible convenience advantage over Founex, an inference rather than a measured delegate preference. Sources: https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/ ; https://www.bernina-geneve.ch/accomodation/ ; https://www.geneve.com/fr/hotels/hotel-bernina
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First contact Andrew Fernandes at the publicly listed editor@swiss-congress.ch. Ask for the original submission/organizer URL, legal organizer name, direct conference manager and confirmation that 5–6 June 2027 and Bernina remain valid. Request referral to Nermin Dzaferbegovic or the current agenda supervisor if needed. Only after authenticating the organizer should sales request attendance, residential nights, accommodation contracting model, Bernina commitment, external-hotel eligibility and any future venue-review date. Do not send a speculative room-block offer or classify sourcing as open. Sources for referral route: https://swiss-congress.ch/contact/ ; https://www.yumpu.com/en/document/view/70863455/swiss-congress-magazine-2025
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Unconfirmed, not open. The June 2027 dates are in the future but appear only in the directory evidence located. Hotel sourcing, contractual exclusivity, delegate self-booking and permission for a satellite hotel are unknown. No event-specific travel evidence supports Geneva Airport arrivals or lodging toward Nyon/La Côte. No Lausanne or French-border activity is established. Source: https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional inference only: obtain the real organizer and evidence of recurrence before seeking a future workshop or residential edition in Founex. No announced post-2027 edition, rotation policy, bid window, RFP or unmet room requirement was verified. This is not yet recurring competitive capture. Source context: https://swiss-congress.ch/conferences/international-conference-on-geospatial-technologies-and-civil-engineering-applications/ ; https://swiss-congress.ch/contact/
